'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed! Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 15 any found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items from the [[Face cover|Facecovers]] category
* Hand over 15 any found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items from the [[Headwear|Headgear]] category
* Hand over 15 any found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items from the [[Earpieces|Headsets]]  category
* Hand over 15 any found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items from the [[Eyewear]] category category
* Hand over 15 any found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items from the [[Body armor|Body Armor]] category category
